clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope  —  Requirements of bitumen mastic for anti-static and electrically conducting grade. Note —In locations where it is necessary to take precautionary measures  against the   accumulation of static electricity, flooring   should have uniform electrical conductance to a degree which will always  ensure that under the fastest rate of  generation  of any charge that can possibly occur in practice, a dangerous potentialcan not exist.

clauses.title: Electrically Conducting
clauses.text: 2.1 Electrically Conducting— Having a upper limit of resistance of 5 × 104 ohms.

clauses.title: Anti
clauses.text: 2.2 Anti-static — Having a resistance of over 5 × 104 ohms and less than 108 ohms.

clauses.title: Bitumen mastic composition for electrical
clauses.text: 4.1 Bitumen mastic composition for electrical conducting and anti-static grade are made by incorporating bitumen in conjunction with other suitable materials like carbon black of the conductive grade like graphite.

clauses.title: The bitumen content shall
clauses.text: 4.1.1   The bitumen content shall be between 13 to 18 percent by mass of the total mastic. Note — For method of preparation of bitumen mastic,refer to clause 4.2 of the standard.

clauses.title: Hardness number of bitumen
clauses.text: 5.1 Hardness number of bitumen mastic as laid shall be 4 to 12 at 35oC unless otherwise agreed to mutually.

clauses.title: Resistance of product after being manufactured
clauses.text: 5.2 Resistance of product after being manufactured shall have electrical conductance between  5 x 104 ohms and 2 × 106 ohms. Properties 4.1 Hardness Number- Unless otherwise agreed between the purchaser and the user, the hardness number of bitumen mastic as laid shall be 4 to 12 at 35oC 4.2 Acid-Resistance- The test specimens shall be subjected to acid-resistance test. The test specimen shall be observed for change of mass, surface cracks, loss of gloss, etching,  pitting, and softening. The concentration of acid solutions to which the specimens to be are tested shall be as specified by the user. 4.2.1  The immersion medium shall be observed for discolouration and the formation of sediments. clauses.title: Finish
clauses.text: 6. Finish—The sheets shall have true shape, good appearance and shall be free from visible defects. The corrugations shall be true and regular. The edges of the sheets shall be straight and clean. External surface of the sheets shall be painted with almunium paint.

clauses.title: Packing
clauses.text: 7. Packing—The sheets shall be packed in accordance with the usual trade practice to avoid damage, discoloration, deformation etc.
